summary: PREVIOUS BLOCKER RESOLVED — /app/frontend/app/dealer/[id].tsx now parses cleanly, Metro bundle loads, app boots, login screen renders, and the dealer detail page mounts. Verified via direct nav to /dealer/{id} after token injection (login UI submit was rate-limited by ngrok preview; bypass used for testing only). Hero, COMPANY tab, ACCOUNTS tab, PURCHASED tap-through, kebab menu, and Edit Dealer slide-up modal ALL work as specified. AGENTS tab is the only outstanding concern: clicking dealer-tab-agents (via .click(force=True) AND via raw mouse click at the testID's bounding box, with up to 3.5s wait) did not visually switch tabs in two attempts — dealer-agents-box was reported MISSING and the COMPANY content remained on screen — even though ACCOUNTS (same code pattern) switched fine. Tab label correctly shows 'AGENTS (1)' so data is available. Recommend main agent verify the AGENTS branch's onPress/render path (possibly a metal TbvFrame remount race or stale closure on setActiveTab for the 'agents' key). All testIDs from the playbook are present in the file; only the runtime switch to the agents tab failed to surface them. No SyntaxError, no red screen, no console errors related to the dealer screen (only unrelated 401/403 from notification + bootstrap endpoints).

rca_of_issue: AGENTS tab: when dealer-tab-agents is tapped, the COMPANY panel remains visible and dealer-agents-box never enters the DOM. Same testing harness, same tap mechanism, and same component class succeeded for COMPANY and ACCOUNTS — so the failure is local to the agents conditional branch. Hypothesis: the agents branch may be unmounting before paint due to a setExpandedRow side-effect when re-entering, or the metal TbvFrame inside CardShell for the agents box is throwing silently in a way that suppresses render. Reproduction: login → /dealer/44de3979-c23f-444b-867e-3b536126bf49 → tap dealer-tab-agents → wait 3s → query [data-testid="dealer-agents-box"] returns null while [data-testid="dealer-tab-agents"] is still present. Mitigation suggestion: add a console.log in the agents JSX gate, confirm setActiveTab('agents') updates state (React DevTools), and ensure the CardShell key prop is unique.
